FDA ENFORCEMENT REPORT - FOOD
Recall number: F-1958-2026   Classification: Class I   Status: Ongoing
Recalling firm: Alder Run Creamery, Petaluma, CA
Product description: Queso fresco soft cheese, 10 oz rounds, 12 per case
Code information: Lot codes AR260915Q2, AR260919Q2 on the case and on each unit, with use-by dates within 30 days of production.
Reason for recall: Product may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes; the organism was found in finished-product testing.
Distribution pattern: Distributed to wholesale distributors in northern CA and NV for retail and food service.
Product quantity: 70 cases
Recall initiation date: 2026-09-27   Report date: 2026-10-03   Voluntary: Firm initiated
